_doc: Single place for the per-network limits that gw-media-content checks (scripts/comprobar.py reads this file; no other file may repeat these numbers). Each rule has valor, marca, fuente (URL) and comprobado (date read). Marks: P = read in the primary source; S = secondary source or search excerpt only; NV = not verified (the check still applies it as a cautious cap, and the skill asks the user to confirm); C = convention of the skill, not a network limit. To refresh: re-read each fuente, update valor/marca/comprobado, keep the same keys (comprobar.py looks them up by key and fails closed when one of its CLAVES is missing), run `python3 skills/gw-media-content/scripts/test_comprobar.py`, and update docs/investigacion/redes-sociales.md section 5 with the new reading. Keys read by comprobar.py: x.longitud, x.url_peso, x.simbolo_ancho_peso, x.hilo_posts, x.imagen_bytes, x.alt_max, reddit.titulo, reddit.normas_dias, reddit.normas_min_caracteres, canal_extra.imagen_formatos, linkedin.longitud, linkedin.imagen_pixeles, linkedin.imagen_formatos, linkedin.alt_max, linkedin.documento_bytes, linkedin.documento_paginas, discord.mensaje, discord.imagen_bytes, discord.alt_max.

longitud.nota: weighted count: Latin = 1, emoji and CJK = 2

simbolo_ancho_peso.nota: weight of an emoji or wide character

hilo_posts.nota: a thread of 1 to 4 posts; X has no thread limit

imagen_bytes.nota: 5 MB per image; JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP

alt_max.nota: X does not publish the alt text limit; 1000 is a cautious cap

titulo.fuente: no source read (reddit.com blocks automatic reading)
titulo.nota: applied as a cautious cap on the title

normas.valor: The subreddit rules must be pasted by the user under «### Normas de r/<subreddit>» in ficha.md, with the date read and the self-promotion rule

normas_dias.nota: «Normas leídas:» may be at most this many days old and not in the future; subreddits change their rules without notice

normas_min_caracteres.nota: the pasted rules block of each subreddit has at least this many characters (whitespace collapsed); it proves the rules were pasted, not that they were read

imagen_formatos.nota: image formats of a channel that is not x, reddit, linkedin or discord (render.mjs writes .webp and .png; a .jpg is accepted as is)

longitud.nota: post text; longer is an article

imagen_pixeles.nota: an image must have fewer pixels than this; weight and aspect ratio are not published

imagen_formatos.nota: LinkedIn takes JPG, PNG and GIF, not WebP (section 5.3 of docs/investigacion/redes-sociales.md); every channel without this key takes .webp (a convention of the skill)

documento_bytes.nota: 100 MB; a PDF is the organic carousel

mensaje.nota: characters per message; split longer text into blocks separated by a line with ---

autopromocion.valor: Set by each server; no verified rule
